privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Welcome to THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS. We value your trust and are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you visit our website, use our services, or interact with us.
sections: Information We Collect

We may collect the following information:

Full Name

Email Address

Mobile Number

Shipping and Billing Address

Payment Information (processed through secure payment gateways)

Order and Transaction Details

Any information voluntarily submitted through forms, inquiries, surveys, or customer support requests You may browse certain sections of our website without providing personal information.
How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

Process and fulfill orders

Provide customer support

Communicate order updates and service notifications

Improve our products, services, and website experience

Respond to inquiries and requests

Send promotional offers, updates, and marketing communications where permitted by law

Comply with legal and regulatory requirements
Information Sharing

THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS does not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. We may share information with:

Logistics and delivery partners

Payment processing partners

Technology and website service providers

Legal or regulatory authorities when required by law Such sharing is limited to the purpose of providing services or complying with legal obligations.
Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to:

Improve website functionality

Remember user preferences

Analyze website traffic and performance

Enhance user experience You may choose to disable cookies through your browser settings. However, certain website features may not function properly if cookies are disabled.
Data Security

We implement reasonable technical, administrative, and physical safeguards to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. While we strive to protect your information, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is completely secure. Therefore, we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Promotional Communications

By registering on our website, placing an order, submitting a form, or providing your contact details, you consent to receive communications from THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS through:

Email

SMS

WhatsApp

Phone Calls

RCS Messages These communications may include order updates, service notifications, promotional offers, and product information. Transactional communications may be sent even if your mobile number is registered under Do Not Disturb (DND), where permitted by applicable law.
Surveys and Contests

From time to time, we may conduct surveys, promotional campaigns, contests, or feedback programs. Information collected through such activities may be used to improve our services and customer experience.
Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or policies of such external websites. Users are encouraged to review the privacy policies of those websites separately.
Children's Privacy
Our services are not intended for individuals under the age of 18 years. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors.
Changes to This Policy
THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS reserves the right to modify or update this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this page along with the updated effective date.
Contact Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal information, please contact us: THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS Email: customercare@theearthmitrafarmers.com By using our website and services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to this Privacy Policy.

refund.title: Return & Refund Policy
refund.intro: THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS At THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS, customer satisfaction is our priority. We are committed to providing high-quality natural, organic, and farm-fresh products. Please read our Cancellation, Return & Refund Policy carefully before placing an order.
sections: Return Policy

Due to the nature of food, organic, agricultural, and consumable products, returns are accepted only in the following situations:

Product received is damaged.

Product received is defective.

Wrong product delivered.

Product received is expired.

The product package is tampered with before delivery. To request a return:

Contact us within 48 hours of delivery.

Provide your order number and clear photographs of the product and packaging.

Return requests received after 48 hours may not be accepted.
Non-Returnable Products

For safety and hygiene reasons, the following items cannot be returned unless damaged or incorrect:

Opened food products

Consumed products

Fresh fruits and vegetables

Perishable items

Products damaged due to improper storage by the customer

Products returned without original packaging
Refund Policy

Refunds will be processed only after verification and approval of the return request. Approved refunds will be issued:

To the original payment method used during purchase.

Within 5–7 business days from approval. For Cash on Delivery (COD) orders:

Refunds may be processed through bank transfer, UPI, or another mutually agreed method.
Replacement Policy

Where possible, we may offer a replacement instead of a refund for:

Damaged products

Defective products

Incorrect products delivered Replacement requests are subject to product availability.
Shipping Charges

● Original shipping charges are generally non-refundable.

If the return is due to our error (wrong, damaged, or defective product), return shipping costs will be borne by THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS.
Contact Information

For cancellations, returns, replacements, or refunds, please contact: THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS Email: customercare@theearthmitrafarmers.com Phone: 7691909306 Address: 2/160/2 A.N. Rajharsh Colony, Nayapura, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh – 462042, India
Policy Updates
THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS reserves the right to modify this Cancellation, Return & Refund Policy at any time. Updated versions will be posted on our website.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
shipping.intro: THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS At THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS, we are committed to delivering fresh, natural, and high-quality products to our customers across India in a timely and secure manner.
sections: Order Processing

● Orders are processed after successful payment confirmation.

Orders are generally processed within 1–2 business days.

Orders placed on Sundays or public holidays may be processed on the next working day.

During peak seasons, sales events, or unforeseen circumstances, processing times may be slightly longer.
Delivery Coverage

● We currently deliver across most locations in India through trusted courier and logistics partners.

Delivery availability may vary depending on the customer's location and courier serviceability.
Estimated Delivery Time

● Metro Cities: 2–5 business days

Tier 2 & Tier 3 Cities: 3–7 business days

Remote Areas: 5–10 business days Delivery timelines are estimates and may vary due to weather conditions, transportation delays, public holidays, natural disasters, government restrictions, or other factors beyond our control.
Shipping Charges

● Shipping charges, if applicable, will be displayed at checkout before payment.

We may offer free shipping on selected products, promotional campaigns, or orders above a specified value.

Any free shipping offers may be modified or withdrawn without prior notice.
Order Tracking

● Once your order is shipped, you may receive shipment details through Email, SMS, or WhatsApp.

Tracking information will be shared when available from our logistics partners.
Delivery Attempts

● Our courier partners may make multiple delivery attempts.

If delivery cannot be completed due to incorrect address, unavailability of the recipient, or refusal to accept the package, the order may be returned to us.

Additional shipping charges may apply for re-shipment.
Delivery Address

Customers are responsible for providing complete and accurate delivery information. THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS shall not be responsible for delays or failed deliveries caused by:

Incorrect address details

Incorrect phone numbers

Incomplete recipient information
Damaged or Tampered Packages

If the package appears damaged, opened, or tampered with at the time of delivery:

Do not accept the package.

Immediately notify our customer support team.

Share photographs of the package for verification.
Risk and Ownership
Ownership and responsibility for products pass to the customer upon successful delivery at the provided shipping address.
Delayed Deliveries

While we make every effort to deliver orders within the estimated timeframe, THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS shall not be held liable for delays caused by:

Natural disasters

Floods

Strikes

Transportation disruptions

Government actions

Technical issues

Other force majeure events
Contact Information

For shipping-related inquiries, please contact: THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS Email: customercare@theearthmitrafarmers.com Phone: 7691909306 Address: 2/160/2 A.N. Rajharsh Colony, Nayapura, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh – 462042, India
Policy Updates
THE EARTH MITRA FARMERS reserves the right to modify this Shipping & Delivery Policy at any time without prior notice. Updated versions will be published on our website.
